resolutions.researcher_notes: Searched 田南-上高支线, 田南-上高-宜丰支线, 田南上高管道 全长/输气能力. The branch's real-world existence is well corroborated: the 2014 Jiangxi DRC gas-utilization plan (img9.qianzhan.com policy PDF, 赣发改规划(2014)325号) lists 田南-上高支线 among 6 trunks+1 branch already built as of 2014 (aggregate 870km system total, no per-segment breakdown given). A second lead, a Jiangxi water-and-soil-conservation completion-acceptance page (jxsks.com CMS, cms/view.do) that two independent WebSearch queries both surfaced, describes a grouped 3-branch acceptance covering 抚河-抚北 + 田南-上高-宜丰 + 石鼻-奉新, combined 68.07km — but this is a GROUP total for 3 branches, not this segment's own 29.41km/0.13bcm figure, so per the aggregate-vs-segment rule it cannot support this cell. The jxsks.com page itself is also currently unfetchable (its Mingsoft CMS returns a bare '主键编号不能为空' 500-class error on every id/param combination tried, both via WebFetch and curl with -k; no Wayback snapshot exists per the availability API) so even the 68.07km aggregate cannot be formally cited — it is an unconfirmed lead for a future pass, not a source. The wiki's own candidate for this unit, a pipechina.com.cn .xls, is a confirmed 404 (in harvest_pool_failed). No source gives the specific 29.41km / 0.13 bcm/y figures at segment granularity. Separately: this row's prior_finding flags that its Chinese name currently sits on P4780 (Jiangxi Natural Gas Pipeline Network, the parent-network aggregate row, batch_01, n_owed=0, no per-segment English name) — that looks like a naming/attribution question on GEM's own data, not a sourcing question, and is noted here for a human to check; not acted on (no value change proposed, no deletion recommended).
